purpose: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for conditional-module render thresholds + grid balance, read by BOTH pl-compose-editorial (what to render) AND pl-audit-v4 (what to require). Closes the suburbs ≥3-vs-≥5 composer/audit drift (codex R109). Fixed skeleton + DATA-driven conditional modules + AI writes content NOT architecture.

minimum_content_signal._doc: pl-audit-v4 GATE 3 (anti-empty-gaming) AND composer render gates read these. ONE rule, no drift.
minimum_content_signal._suburbs_note: 3 (NOT 5) is deliberate: a-j-roofing is a LEGITIMATE thin client with 3 real suburbs (YELLOW). Raising to 5 would block valid output, so codex R109 'prefer stricter unless it breaks valid output' resolves to 3. The old audit comments/threshold-string that said '≥5' were wrong — code always used 3.

conditional_render._doc: A module renders only when its data clears the threshold (data decides which modules show — codex R109). Never fabricate/drop content to fit; the LAYOUT adapts (see grid_balance).

grid_balance._doc: No item-grid may leave a LONE item alone on the last row (items % cols == 1). Composer picks a balanced column count for the real item count; pl-audit-v4 grid_balance flags any residual orphan; a CSS center-last rule handles rare residue (e.g. 7-in-3col). Items are NEVER dropped or fabricated to fit (Matthew 2026-05-30).
